meta.manifestAlgorithm: Python sorted(Path.rglob("*")) path-component order; for each file: relative POSIX path + NUL + sha256(file bytes) + LF; SHA256 of concatenated UTF-8

version._comment: Single source of truth for the packaged version. scripts/build_desktop.ps1 and scripts/build_apk.ps1 read this and sync desktop/package.json + android/app/build.gradle from it, so an exe and an APK can never disagree.
